Procedural districts · dense urban, suburbs, residential and business

Nine district types, each at seeds 214 and 215, plus two connected mixed-city examples. All use cardinal streets and a 5-metre cell scale. Same complete recipe and bundled reference snapshots produce identical maps.

New OpenStreetMap calibration samples: Midtown Manhattan, Chicago Loop, Philadelphia rowhouses, Irvine/Woodbridge and Naperville. Urban apartments use the existing published Prague/Bubeneč sample; business campuses are explicitly designed. These generated maps are fictional adaptations, not exact geographic replicas.

Interior colours: purple apartments; light blue terrace homes; green detached homes; gold retail; blue offices; pink hotels. Colours, building uses and storeys are placement hints in metadata; the game currently loads unpopulated 2D terrain. No NPC jobs, inventories, upper-floor simulation or vehicle lanes are added.

Mixed cities keep district identities and connect neighbouring districts with physical road portals. Every generated map is checked for connected roads, reachable entrances and room/floor budgets.
